entries.text: Tack: absorbing electrical current while staring at the hangar ceiling rafters: "All systems drawing power safely, Zeeb. The horizon can wait just a little longer."

entries.text: the Little Dart Mk 32 is finished. It actually hovered off the hangar floor. Nobody believes him.
